description: backlog add mints a random (secrets.token_hex) item id and appends one v=1/crc32 routing.log record; backlog show reads it back by that id. The id is captured from step 0's stdout and threaded into step 1's argv, since it cannot be predicted (unlike a dispatch task id, it is not content-hashed).

.multiverse/routing.log.regex: ^<TIMESTAMP>	v=1	seq=1	event=backlog	item=<ID>	state=open	priority=P2	title="fix the thing"	why="it breaks sometimes"	by=sandbox	crc32=<CRC32>$
